name: Hassobeba
title: Descendants of the Tribe of Judah
summary: Hassobeba (also called Ha-Tsobeba) is mentioned in 1 Chronicles as part of the genealogy of the tribe of Judah. She is listed among the descendants of Koz. Very little is known about this person beyond the genealogical record.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the Genealogy of Judah
keyEvents.description: Hassobeba is mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah in 1 Chronicles, as part of the descendants of Koz.

keyEvents.title: Part of Judah's Lineage
keyEvents.description: Hassobeba belonged to the important tribe of Judah, one of the twelve tribes of Israel and the tribe from which the messianic line came.

keyEvents.title: Koz's Family
keyEvents.description: Hassobeba is connected to Koz, who was the father of Anub and Hassobeba, and to the families of Aharhel, son of Harum.

keyEvents.title: Genealogies After the Exile
keyEvents.description: The genealogies in 1 Chronicles were compiled to preserve Israel's identity after the return from the Babylonian exile, and Hassobeba is part of this important historical document.
